evaluations.rationale: No other story imposes an incompatible permission, behavior, constraint, or rule with creating a game by entering name/description.
Inviting estimators via URL is not inconsistent with any other story's permissions or rules.
Starting a round by entering an item in a single multi-line field does not conflict with other behaviors or constraints.
Seeing all items in the session does not impose rules incompatible with other stories.
Selecting an item to be estimated or re-estimated is compatible with other stories.
Adding an item to the list is not inconsistent with any other story's rules.
Editing an item in the list does not conflict with other permissions or behaviors.
Deleting an item from the list is consistent with other stories; no incompatible constraint found.

evaluations.evidence: show all estimates immediately, so that I can decide to show the estimates that have been given even though not all estimators have given their estimate
evaluations.rationale: This permission to reveal estimates before all have given conflicts with PP-033, which requires that all estimates be shown at the same time after all estimators have given to ensure independence.
Accepting the average of all estimates when agreed does not contradict other stories.
Auto-filling estimate when all estimators show same card is not incompatible with other requirements.
Moderator entering agreed-upon estimate is consistent with other stories.
Re-estimating a previously estimated story does not conflict with any other story's rules.
Importing stories from a spreadsheet is compatible with other backlog items.
Copy/paste stories from spreadsheet imposes no incompatible constraint with others.
Browsing previous games is not inconsistent with deletion or export behaviors.
Viewing a transcript of a game aligns with export and viewing features; no inconsistencies found.
Exporting transcript as HTML is compatible with other storage/export stories.
Exporting transcript as CSV does not conflict with other backlog items.
Deleting a game so stories and estimates are no longer stored is consistent with browsing and export features (no contradictory rule).
Creating an account with details does not conflict with other stories.
Logging in with account name and password is not inconsistent with other requirements.
Changing account details is compatible with other account stories.
Deleting an account so account information and games are no longer stored does not conflict with other stories (consistent with delete-game story).
Displaying dates/times in local timezone imposes no incompatible constraint with other stories.
Password reminder by email is compatible with account management stories.
Selecting card value sets does not conflict with other stories.
Inviting up to 15 estimators is not incompatible with any other story's constraints.
Estimator joining by entering name via URL is compatible with invite flow.
Estimator seeing the item being estimated does not conflict with other features.
Seeing all items for the session is consistent with other stories.
Seeing that an estimate has been given by a specific estimator (presence, not value) does not conflict with other rules.

evaluations.evidence: be shown all estimates at the same time after all estimators have given their estimate, so that I can be sure estimates are independent
evaluations.rationale: This requirement that estimates be revealed only after all have given conflicts with PP-009, which allows the moderator to show estimates immediately before everyone has estimated.
Allowing changes up until the last person selects is compatible with reveal/timing stories (aside from PP-009/PP-033 conflict which involves reveal timing, not this change window).
Seeing each estimator's prior estimates for the story is not inconsistent with other stories.
Seeing who gave what estimates during the current round is compatible with reveal-after-all requirement (it can apply after reveal) and does not inherently conflict with other stories.
Starting a two-minute visible countdown is not incompatible with other backlog items.
Resetting the timer as soon as all play an estimate is consistent with other timing/interaction stories.
Scrolling back through prior rounds' stories and estimates does not conflict with other stories (storage/export may be relevant but not inconsistent).
Having cards in same order across draws is not incompatible with other requirements.
Changing estimate as long as draw not completed aligns with other stories about timing and does not conflict.
Displaying a small thumbnail near played cards is a UI preference and not inconsistent with other stories.
Compliance with XHTML/CSS standards does not conflict with other functional requirements.
Having a list of definitions is not inconsistent with other stories.
Creating database indexes for performance is not inconsistent with other backlog items.
Supporting older browsers is a compatibility requirement and not conflicting with other stories.
W3C accessibility compliance does not impose rules that conflict with other backlog items.
Application responsiveness requirement does not contradict other stories.
Unicode support does not conflict with other backlog items.
Sensible and predictable URLs are compatible with other features.
Having nice error pages is not incompatible with other requirements.
Storing research results non-identifiably can coexist with in-app attribution during live sessions; no direct contradiction with other stories.
Seeing some metrics on use of the game does not conflict with other requirements.
